_comment: Wet-lab-validated primer sets that must be preferred over a fresh computational design whenever their genomic (isolate-annealing) body matches the requested isolate's curated sequence. Keyed by 'gene|application' (application implies vector: deletion -> pEXG2, expression -> pBBR1MCS2). Only the isolate-annealing body is fixed here; vector-homology tails (and, for expression, the RBS) are always derived the same way as for computationally-designed primers (vectors.derive_tails / RBS_TAIL_PART), so the tool's own tail conventions stay authoritative and self-consistent. See lib/primer_design/fixed_primers.py.

lasB|deletion.note: PA14 lasB in-frame deletion set. Retained scar confirmed directly with the primer designer 2026-07-27: MKKVSTLDLLFVAFSTVGVTCPSAL* (N=13, C=12; scar_orf reproduces it byte-for-byte on PA14/LB001/LB019). N/C is stored directly rather than inferred from where P2/P3 anneal, since the sequence is locally repetitive right at the junction (N=13/C=12 and N=12/C=13 both reproduce the same scar) and the P2/P3 bodies don't need to terminate exactly at the boundary. P4 anneals ~628 nt downstream of the stop codon, i.e. outside the curated 600 nt dn_flank window — matching against this isolate's genome may require widening the flank from the full genome (see fixed_primers._wide_flanks). P4's body (starts with T) regenerates one HindIII site at the P3/P4 vector junction instead of the usual 0 for pEXG2|HindIII|deletion (site_destroyed) — confirmed intentional/accepted by the primer designer 2026-07-27, so expected_recognition_count is overridden to 1 for this gene only.

lasR|deletion.note: PA14 lasR in-frame deletion set. N/C match the calibration already documented in lib/primer_design/config.py (PA14 lasR N=6, C=13) and were re-derived cleanly from where P2/P3 anneal (in-frame, unambiguous — unlike lasB).

lasI|deletion.note: PA14 lasI in-frame deletion set. N/C re-derived cleanly from where P2/P3 anneal (in-frame, unambiguous).

lasB|expression.note: PA14 lasB complementation set (pBBR1MCS-2). P1 body includes 8 nt of native upstream context between the RBS and the start codon (annealed from the genome, not the tool's synthetic spacer) — confirmed with the primer designer 2026-07-27.
